Done. All 29 test cases pass.

## Changes

**`yacht.h`** — declares the scoring function:
```cpp
int score(const std::vector<int>& dice, const std::string& category);
```

**`yacht.cpp`** — implements `yacht::score` by tallying face counts and the total, then dispatching on the category string:
- **`ones`–`sixes`**: face value × count of that face
- **`full house`**: total only when some face appears exactly 3 times and another exactly 2 (so four-of-a-kind and yacht correctly score 0)
- **`four of a kind`**: 4 × face for any face with count ≥ 4 (a yacht scores here)
- **`little straight` / `big straight`**: 30 only when each of 1–5 / 2–6 appears exactly once
- **`choice`**: sum of all dice
- **`yacht`**: 50 only when all five dice match

No test or build files were modified, and the temporary compile helper was removed after verification.
